title: Evidence retention policy simulator and report exporter
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description:
Summary:
Build a simulator and export pipeline that lets internal operators and customer auditors validate retention policies across regions and storage tiers and produce auditor-ready evidence bundles (CSV/JSON + signed manifest). The simulator should model retention lifecycle events (ingest, TTL expiry, archival, deletion, restoration) and produce deterministic, replayable evidence records mapped to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls.

Goals:
- Provide a UI + API to define a retention policy (by region, dataset tag, and storage class) and run a simulation against historical or synthetic event traces.
- Surface a timeline of actions and show which control assertions each action satisfies (control mapping for e.g., CC6.1, A.8.3.3).
- Produce exportable evidence bundles: 1) human-readable CSV with canonical columns, 2) machine-verified JSON with signatures, 3) a zipped package including PRs/links and an auto-generated attestation narrative.
- Integrate with KMS metadata and with existing evidence collectors so exports include location and encryption key fingerprints where applicable.

Scope and non-goals:
- Scope: product-facing simulator, export pipeline, control mapping matrix, sample auditor narrative, integration points for collectors and KMS metadata. Includes backfill adapter to run simulation on up to 90 days of events.
- Non-goal: full forensic replay of raw object bytes or building new cryptographic time-stamping service. We will rely on existing audit logs and KMS fingerprints for verification.

Acceptance criteria:
- PM-94812 simulator UI where operator can define retention policies and run a simulation that completes within 10m for 30 days of events.
- Generated evidence bundle conforms to exporter schema and contains signed manifest (signature tied to customer workspace id and KMS fingerprint).
- Control mapping table shows a mapping for at least 12 SOC 2/ISO controls and is editable by compliance team.
- API: /v1/compliance/simulate (POST) accepts policy JSON and returns simulation_id, status, and download link for bundle when complete.
- End-to-end integration tests that validate bundle schema and attach to the release pipeline.

Design decisions and trade-offs considered:
- Deterministic simulation vs stochastic sampling: deterministic replay of recorded events preferred for auditor reproducibility; synthetic augmentation allowed but must be flagged in the manifest.
- Signed manifests vs full notarization: signed manifest (KMS fingerprint) chosen for speed and leverages existing KMS/HSM integrations.
- UI complexity: provide a simple policy DSL for operators and a separate advanced JSON editor for auditors.

Data model (canonical columns for CSV export):
- timestamp, event_type, resource_id, region, storage_class, retention_policy_id, action_taken, actor_id, kAuditLogLink, kms_key_fingerprint, evidence_tag, control_mapped

Security and privacy:
- All export bundles for customer-managed accounts must be encrypted at rest and signed. Exports for hosted workspaces use short-lived signed URLs (24h) and audit entries for download operations.
- PII minimization: by default obfuscate user identifiers with reversible token mapping and include mapping only if expressly requested and approved by compliance.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: spike and API prototype; alignment with compliance and security; demo simulation on synthetic dataset.
- Week 2: UI wireframe + backend implementation; integrate with collectors to fetch event traces.
- Week 3: export schema finalization, KMS signing integration, and E2E tests.
- Week 4: internal audit-run with compliance and pilot with two customers.

Metrics to show success:
- Time to produce bundle (target < 10m for 30-day trace).
- Number of controls auto-mapped correctly (target >= 12).
- Customer pilot NPS and reduction in manual evidence requests (target 50% fewer manual requests for retention proofs).

Links & artifacts:
- Design sketch: https://confluence.redwood/display/COMPL/Retention+Simulator+Sketch
- API spec (draft): https://docs.redwood/api/compliance/simulate
